facts.fact: The Harare Internet Exchange Point (HIX), housed at the TelOne Exchange in Harare and set up with a USD 200,000 African Union grant, is operating, and POTRAZ says all internet access providers are connected to it; the document has no publication date and is placed at the October 2020 ITU forum.

POTRAZ says HIX has two international peers, Packet Clearing House and Quad9 (Quad Nine Secure DNS), while it still needs to attract more regional players; the document has no publication date and is placed at the October 2020 ITU forum.

note: About a proposed SADC regional exchange, Botswana against an unnamed Zimbabwean company shortlisted; no operating exchange in ZWE stated.
ZINX is named only as a proposed peering partner and CDN caches are proposed for a Starlink Harare PoP; no statement that an exchange is in service.
Exchanges named (NAPAfrica, JINX, KIXP, IXPN) are in other countries; nothing for ZWE.

facts.fact: The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for Zimbabwe: HIXP, Harare.

note: IXPs are only discussed as a regional priority; no Zimbabwe exchange point is stated in service.
